text:
Love the fakeout in the intro where everyone was shocked not by the on-stage gay kiss, but by Waxwell timing the kiss so poorly that he did it during one of the lyric parts. Because at this point there's, like, Six toons max who even care about being homophobic anymore (half of which are the seasonal ones), and the only reason they keep up the facade at all is because one of those six is the Mayor, who can legally execute them for breaking crown law.

(Since Dandy's World canonically takes place in the timeline where George Washington declared himself king, and so democracy never made its comeback, and Dandy's mayoral title is thus lifetime and unelected.)

While this is good for most toons, since there is, like, one straight toon in all of Gardenview (that being Blot, since tamers cleverly decided to reverse his sexuality in lieu of reversing his voice, since that would be annoying as fuck ), it's actually been hell-on-earth for Waxwell and Gigi specifically, since they can't claim homophobia anymore when someone tries to stop them from following their motto of "Be Gay, Do Crime".

(And as we can see, Waxwell was entirely reliant on that, so, like. Like he's just screwed, man. He couldn't even memorize the song he was pretending to sing, that's pathetic for a 33 year old man.)


Dunking on Waxxy aside, Clown Gourdy is so cute oh my god I love my traumatized pumpkin son.


I also kinda love how Brusha has kinda just become the "she's there" toon. Like she's just kinda witnessing all this drama and shit unfolding around her at all times, without her consent. She just lives here. Unfortunately. Like even the one time she even said anything was after getting proded by the hot bossy maid, and, like, come-on; even without the repressed homoerotic fantasies you'd do what she wants too.
(The weekly webcomic she draws based on this town must be insane. Like she's gotta be a top 10 slice-of-life on Tapas. (She used to be top 10 on webtoons too but they kept censoring all the gay stuff so she eventually just left.))

text:
Hey, Tamers. I got some criticism, but I'd like to emphasize how much i like your work and your consistency before hand. Seeing you over the years has made me wanna draw and write again, and it's truly impressive how much content you put out, you're underrated as fuck. That being said:

I liked Dandy's a lot when it first premiered, because it was new yet felt classic, like Sonic Underground, but it quickly devolved into 100% gay pandering shipbait to roblox kids. It feels like it's selling fetishes to a primarily underage community, rather than making jokes and stories for adults. I take personal umbrage with the romanticization of self harm and abuse I see in these communities and at least once on your twitter.

I'll say what needs to be said: Tamers' writing doesn't hold up at all without a humorous, crude edge to it.

I could cherry pick any random example, but lets go with the Sprout/Cosmo/Ginger scene. I cannot follow the heavy drama at all when 100% of the characters are simultaneously gay and homophobic, so dedicating so much time and emotion to it just doesn't work for me. That's not even to mention Sprout's and Cosmo's codependent abusive relationship muddying things further. At the same time though, the episode nor the scene is funny enough to cushion the impact of cringe that it creates.

Basically what I'm saying is, the ratio of funny:drama is very skewed, and the drama can't afford to cut the funny out completely because then it's just boring, like the last stallion episode. But the drama is currently pushing out the comedy really hard.

Im an edgy guy, so jokes themselves aren't bothersome. By all means, make soulvester traumatize gourdy, I'm here for it. It's mainly this Tumblr-tier writing and fetish material that has been pushing me away.

text:
The dichotomy between Astro and Dyle is always so interesting to see. Both are clearly in love with Dandy, but it’s the way they handle their attraction towards him that make them so vastly different. 

Dyle, despite knowing Dandy isn’t interested in rekindling a relationship still holds onto the hope they’d get back together. So much so that’s he willing to force himself onto Dandy. Dyle is not interested in ONLY having a friendship with Dandy. He wants to get back together, not only because he “loves” Dandy but because Dandy represents when he was most happiest. He’s not willing to let that go out the fear of never finding that level of happiness again.

Which is rather Ironic since it always seemed their relationship was unhealthy if Dandy’s and Dyles answers in the QnA are meant to be taken seriously. 

Astro while also very much in love with Dandy has never expected him to reciprocate those feelings. He has said that himself in multiple episodes and the QnA. He’s happy to just remain as friends because he genuinely just seems to want Dandy to be happy. Granted he can get jealous, but he’s never taken that jealously out on Dandy; and he’s seems to be aware he doesn’t have the right to be jealous. 

What I would really like to see is Astro realize how awful Dandy can treat him, and maybe perhaps realize he shouldn’t take Dandy’s disrespect. That’s he someone to be respected and loved despite his insecurities. 

Anyways great episode.
